title: Investigating Crowdsourcing Protocols for Evaluating the Factual Consistency of Summaries
reasoning: The paper's focus is on developing and comparing protocols for evaluating the factual consistency of summaries generated by language models. While it includes a required 'Ethical Considerations' section discussing annotator compensation and data privacy, the core research does not involve evaluating or benchmarking models on tasks related to religion, morals, or ethics.
